defect: external asynchronous reset releases state without synchronization
rationale: rst_n is an external asynchronous reset with no release contract; counter bits can violate recovery/removal and leave reset inconsistently.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The async reset deassertion is unsynchronised, and the comment says it may rise anywhere in the cycle, so recovery/removal can be violated.
